quotes.text: It's not my role to come in and say you need to do this because I'm super smart. What I should do is ask a bunch of questions of the people that know and understand where their pains are.
You need to be paying attention to how am I driving value to my customers beyond just being a paper pusher. Because that's a lot of GCs. They're project pilers.
Use it as a thought partner, not the thought leader. If you're still thinking this is good for email, you have not gone deep enough.
